nodes.label: Swift

nodes.label: Planning and Design
nodes.definition: The phase of software development involving planning and designing the architecture and user experience.

nodes.label: asset
nodes.definition: A resource file such as images, sounds, or data used in a project.

nodes.label: project
nodes.definition: A collection of source code and resources that make up an application.

nodes.label: Import
nodes.definition: The action of bringing an asset into a project.

nodes.label: use
nodes.definition: The action of utilizing an asset within a project.

nodes.label: Select
nodes.definition: The action of choosing appropriate actions from a set.

nodes.label: actions
nodes.definition: Operations or functions that can be performed on or within the user interface.

nodes.label: configure
nodes.definition: The action of setting up or adjusting the properties of the user interface.

nodes.label: user interface
nodes.definition: The visual and interactive components of an application.
